# Apply the budget filter to the departure flight results

)

)

# Apply the neighborhood filter for Downtown Raleigh

    prior_results=from_cache_hotels,
    neighborhood=["Downtown Raleigh"]
)

# Save the filtered hotel results back to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Find the nearest attraction to the North Carolina State Capitol

attractions_search = search_attractions(
    city="Raleigh"
)

# Save the attraction search results to cache

    attractions=attractions_search,
    groupBy="attraction"
)

print("No planning needed")
